units.source_text: 汽车驶过下游模型般的白桥。

en.t: The car drove across the white bridge downstream, which looked like a model.

units.source_text: 川流不息的红色，仿佛把沿着街道一直伸向远方的开阔的山峡也吞噬了。

en.t: The endless flow of red seemed to swallow even the broad mountain gorge that stretched far into the distance along the road.
